decision: Hold public aggregate and count from display and Experience Score.
thirdPartyReuse: No affirmative authorization for Harbor located.

knownFacts.calculation: Individual likelihood-to-recommend answers are converted into stars and averaged. Public star rating differs from NPS.
knownFacts.publication: Subscriber may choose promoter testimonials only, all feedback with or without visitor filtering, or no public feedback. A public review may be removed while the original feedback remains in the application.
knownFacts.denominator: Publisher documentation describes an average across responses but does not state whether promoter-only display, comment suppression or public removals affect the public numerator or count. Available documentation establishes neither that all responses count nor that only visible testimonials count.
knownFacts.rights: The published customer contract limits the service license to the customer. Sections 2.3 and 4 restrict extraction, while section 4 describes customer-enabled API data sharing with appropriate rights. Section 3.2 grants Listen360 rights in deidentified aggregates and grants Harbor no branch-specific publication rights.

exampleLimitation: Prior receipt only. The 20 displayed accounts cannot establish the inclusion rules for the 78 headline reviews.
requirementsForRelease: Document branch and respondent population, time window, rating denominator, neutral and negative response handling, repeat responses, and the effect of deletions or selective display on the public rating and count.
Obtain an authorized branch export or permitted interface plus explicit rights to publish branch-level statistics in Harbor and use them for scoring.
